title: Israeli army withdraws from Hebron after operation displaces thousands of Palestinians
summary: Israeli forces withdrew from a neighbourhood in the occupied West Bank city of Hebron on Monday, ending a military operation launched after two Israeli soldiers were killed in late October. Thousands of Palestinians displaced during the raid have begun returning to homes, many of which were damaged or ransacked.

title: Iran warns renewed war with US could outlast previous conflict
summary: Iran on Sunday said that a renewed war with the United States could last longer than the previous round of fighting, as President Donald Trump suggested that Washington still had targets to strike. Tehran threatened retaliation without geographical limits while diplomatic efforts continued to avert a fresh escalation ahead of Tuesday's US midterm elections.

summary: Nearly two years after Assad’s fall, Syria has made significant gains in press freedom, but the al-Sharaa government’s opaque communication, reliance on loyal influencers and inconsistent approach to free speech threaten to undermine public trust. title: Iran's Khamenei warns US and Israel against new attacks
titleRu: Президент Ирана Хаменеи предостерегает США и Израиль от новых атак
summary: Iran's supreme leader warned the United States and Israel on Saturday against further strikes as tensions mount over a possible return to fighting. US President Donald Trump and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu have threatened new military action on Tehran but US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said Trump had not yet made a decision on fresh strikes.
